abstract: The medical records and histopathology of all ovarian germ cell tumours (OGCT) in a tertiary centre between 1980 and 1996 were reviewed. Response, overall survival (OS), relapse-free survival (RFS) and prognostic factors were analysed. Sixty-seven patients with OGCT were identified and treated, including 33 dysgerminomas, 18 immature teratomas, 10 endodermal sinus tumours, and 6 mixed tumours. Fifty-three patients (79%) received conservative surgery, 24 (36%) had residual disease post-primary surgery, and 43 (64%) had chemotherapy. Complete response was achieved in 62 patients (93%), 4 out of 5 patients who relapsed were successfully salvaged; OS and RFS at 5 years were 89% and 76%, respectively. Advancing stage of disease was the only significant adverse prognostic factor (p = 0.0001 for OS, and 0.0003 for RFS at 5 years). Out of 44 women with the potential to conceive following treatment, there were 16 successful pregnancies. None of the children born subsequent to the chemotherapy were reported to have any congenital abnormalities. The review indicates a high cure rate in OGCT with combined surgery and chemotherapy and that conservative surgery and preservation of fertility are feasible.
abstract_ja: ある三次医療施設において、1980年から1996年までに治療されたすべての卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(OGCT)の診療記録と病理組織学を後方視的に検討した。奏効、全生存期間(全生存率)(OS)、無再発生存期間(RFS)および予後因子を解析した。OGCT 67例が同定・治療され、内訳はディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）33例、未熟奇形腫18例、卵黄嚢腫瘍10例、混合型6例であった。53例(79%)は温存手術を受け、24例(36%)は初回手術後に残存病変を有し、43例(64%)は化学療法を受けた。62例(93%)で完全奏効が得られ、再発した5例のうち4例は救済に成功した。5年OSおよびRFSはそれぞれ89%と76%であった。進行期は唯一の有意な不良予後因子であった(OSでp=0.0001、RFSでp=0.0003)。治療後に妊娠を希望しうる44例のうち16例が妊娠に成功した。化学療法後に出生した児に先天異常は報告されなかった。本研究は、手術と化学療法の併用によりOGCTの治癒率が高いこと、また温存手術と妊孕性の温存が実施可能であることを示している。
